metaDescription: What {brand} offers, what it doesn't, and how payment, key delivery, refunds and the key guarantee work.

hero.title: A store for game keys, codes and gift cards
hero.lead: {brand} offers activation keys for games and DLC, subscription codes, gift cards, top-ups and software to customers in the {countries}. You buy each key from us, at the price shown, and we issue it to your account after your payment is confirmed.

range.title: What we offer
range.body: Six kinds of product, each with its own page and filters for platform, region, genre and language:

listing.title: What every product page shows
listing.platform: The platform the key is redeemed on and the account you need for it.
listing.region: The activation region, and the languages the publisher lists.
listing.edition: The edition, a subscription's duration or a gift card's value and currency.
listing.prices: A price you can view in {currencies}, checked again before you pay.

items.marketplace: Buy keys from users or let users exchange keys with each other. {brand} is a store: every key comes from us.
items.cases: Offer random or mystery keys, loot boxes or anything with a random outcome.
items.accounts: Offer game or platform accounts, or ask for your platform password.
items.other: Offer keys that need a VPN, or keys for regions we don't serve.

order.label: Payment
order.body: Pay by card ({cardMethods}) on our payment provider's secure page. Prices can be shown in {currencies}.

delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.body: Your key appears on your order page, {usual}. We email you when it is ready.

guarantee.label: Key guarantee
guarantee.body: If a key does not activate, tell us within {claimDays} days of delivery and we replace it or refund it within {refundDays} days.

withdrawal.label: Cancelling
withdrawal.body: You can cancel for free until your key is issued. The {days}-day right to cancel ends once delivery has begun at your request.
